subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw make periodic memory sync a non-zero default fallback for unconfigured users, or keep interval sync opt-in and document the workaround?
rationale: The source fix is clear, but repository policy treats config/default and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive because existing users may gain new background indexing work on upgrade.

options.title: Approve default-on fallback after repair
options.body: Land a scoped version of the linked fix that marks memory dirty only for memory-source managers and defaults unconfigured interval sync to a documented non-zero value.

options.title: Keep interval opt-in
options.body: Preserve the 0 default and improve docs or diagnostics so users can choose intervalMinutes when watcher reliability is suspect.

options.title: Defer default decision
options.body: Land only watcher/error resilience work now and keep the default fallback question open for a separate product decision.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Land a scoped version of the linked fix that marks memory dirty only for memory-source managers and defaults unconfigured interval sync to a documented non-zero value.
